page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of the opening); running head at top, one main text column, a bracketed marginal label "Pæna" with Suspensio / Excommunicatio beside the text as a small two-line block within the column; a short note at the foot of the text. No left-hand page text is legible in the scan's left strip.
page.running_head: Lib.5. De speciali. in politeia diuina.

main_text.p: lem iniueantur & sentiant. Prou.5.12. 1. Cor. 14. 2. 3.4. 5. In interna dispositione cum actione coniuncta, est ex priore ad cor confractum & contritum adduci.2.Cor.3.4.5.6.7.8. Fructus perceptio est ut ex sensu illo ad resipiscentiam, coram multis vel omnibus, lachrymarum, obtestationum, suspiciorum ardentibus desiderijs, absolutionem petentibus ratam faciant. 1.Cor.5.5. 2.Cor.2.3.4.5.6. 7.8 9.
Pæna est Suspensio. Excomunicatio. Num.9.10.13. Luc. 6.22.

Suspensio,est pæna inflicta, quæ ἀφορισμῷ à sacris quibusdam, siue communibus, siue administrarum proprijs,ad tempus constitutum versatur.Gen.42.3: 4. Iob.42.7.8.Ier.36.5.Math.5.23.Nu.14.44.1.Cor. 11. 28. Quare cum his hac nota designatis commercia ne habeantur ut eos pudeat; ut fratres tamen monendi sunt.2.Thes.3.14.

Excomunicatio est pæna inflicta,quæ versetur in absoluta separatione à communione bonorum & illorum priuilegijs.Gen.17.14.Leuit.7.15.16.17.18. Hezr.10.8. Math.18.17. 1.Cor 5.5.13. Quare cum his etiam ne commedamus prohibemur.1.Cor.5.11.
Anathematis censura,est pæna tantum peccanti in spirit.sanct.debita: qua quispiam absq; omni spe in æternum exitiu devouetur.Ge.4.14. Mal.3.v/t. 1.Cor. 16.22.2.Tim.4.14.cum 1.Tim.1.20.Apoc.22.3.

p.i: Atq; hæc de censuris & omnibus rebus Iehouæ post lapsum communibus.

page.notes: Page is a right-hand page; the marginal letters at the left edge belong to the facing page. The marginal "Pæna" bracket block is set within the column and is transcribed in place. Greek word ἀφορισμῷ is approximate. Several Latin words in the scan are blurred and uncertain (e.g. "Quare", "versatur"); reading is best effort.
